title: agentcheckup JSON report
description: Output of `agentcheckup --format json`. Positions are 1-based; columns count UTF-16 code units. Paths are POSIX and relative to the scan root. Strings are data from the scanned repository: treat them as untrusted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this report shape. Incremented on any incompatible change.

fingerprintVersion.description: Version of the scheme that computes each finding's `fingerprint`. `--baseline` refuses a report with another version, and reads a report without this field as version 1.

artifacts.description: Recognized agent configuration files, sorted by path.

findings.description: Sorted by path, line, column, rule id. Includes suppressed findings, marked with `suppressed`.

summary.description: Counts of unsuppressed findings by severity, and of suppressed findings.

rules.description: Metadata of every rule that ran, plus the inline-directive rules, sorted by id.

skipped.description: Files that were found but not checked.

ruleFailures.description: Rules that crashed. Non-empty means the results are incomplete.

pathBase.description: The directory prefix added to every path so that paths read relative to where the command ran (POSIX, no trailing slash). Absent or empty when paths are relative to the scanned directory. `--baseline` removes it before comparing two reports.

policy.description: The check against the `--policy` file. Violations are not findings: they have no rule id, never change the score, and no configuration or directive can suppress them. Messages hold raw repository text, quoted, on one line and bounded in length; they carry no `path:line`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy file's bytes, as `shasum -a 256` prints it.

mode.description: `enforce` fails the run on violations; `audit` reports them and never fails.

insideScanRoot.description: True when the policy file lies inside the scanned directory, so a change under review can edit it.

checks.description: How many checks the policy turns on.

violations.description: Sorted by check, then path, line and id.

id.description: What a baseline comparison matches: the check, the subject and, for an inventory item, its digest. Relative to the scanned directory: never carries `pathBase`.

entry.description: What the violation is about: the server in allowlist form, the `forbid` name, the denied tools and commands, the hook requirement, the agent, the model value (`unknown` when it cannot be read), or the `incomplete` entry.

baseline.description: Set when the scan ran with `--baseline`.

fails.description: True when this violation fails the run (exit code 1).

notes.description: Remarks on the whole run, such as audit mode or a baseline without load plans.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the scan root.

range.description: `end` is exclusive: the position just after the last character.

readers.description: Platforms that read this kind of file.

fixClass.description: `safe`: deterministic, one correct form, applied by `agentcheckup fix --write`. `review`: applied only with `--write --review` or when accepted in `-i`. A finding without a fix needs a manual change.

offset.description: 0-based offset into the decoded text (BOM removed), in UTF-16 code units.

fileChange.description: One change to one file. `edit`: text edits to an existing file. `create`: a new file; the path must not exist. `rename`: moves a file and never overwrites. `encoding`: re-encodes the file as UTF-8 without a byte order mark.

edits.description: Offsets index the text before this change. Edits do not overlap.

fix.description: A repair for the finding. Preview it with `agentcheckup fix`.

changes.description: Applied in order. A change after a rename names the file by its new path. Empty exactly when the fix has `input`.

warning.description: A banner to show before and after the fix.

alternatives.description: Other fixes for the same finding, offered by `agentcheckup fix -i`.

fixInput.description: What a fix needs from the user before it can change anything; only `agentcheckup fix -i` asks. `field` decides how the answer is checked.

target.description: `frontmatter`: the value of top-level key `key`, written as `prefix`, the answer and `suffix`. `directive`: an `agentcheckup-disable-next-line` comment for `ruleId` with the answer as its reason, inserted before `line`.

fingerprint.description: `<hash>:<occurrence>`. Stable across lines inserted above and reformatting: in a JSON file the hash covers the JSON path and canonical value the finding points at, elsewhere the normalized text of its line. See `fingerprintVersion`.

guidance.description: A manual step that the message does not already state.

baseline.description: Set when the scan ran with `--baseline`: `new` when no baseline finding is left to match the fingerprint, otherwise `unchanged`.

score.description: 0 to 100, or null when no agent configuration files were found.

capped.description: True when an unsuppressed risk error capped the score.

checked.description: ISO date when the behavior was last checked against this source.

severity.description: Default severity. A finding may override it.

since.description: Rule set version that introduced the rule.

fix.description: Present when the rule can attach a fix: the classes its fixes may have, and what they do.

target.description: The link text as stored on disk.

relativePath.description: POSIX path relative to the scan root. Empty for the root itself.

contextAgent.description: Agents with a load model, in report order: platform order, with the Copilot surfaces (CLI, VS Code, cloud agent) next to each other. `windsurf` is Devin Local.

loadTrigger.description: When the agent adds the entry to the model's context. `unknown`: the agent reads the file, but when is not documented.

certainty.description: How a loading claim is backed. Text output marks `unverified` with "?".

bytes.description: Size of the file on disk.

chars.description: Code points the agent receives after documented transforms.

tokens.description: Estimate: `ceil(chars / 4)`. Never drives a finding or the score.

loadEntry.description: One thing the agent loads, or may load once its trigger fires.

position.description: 1-based assembly order of startup context. Startup entries only.

path.description: The path as the agent reaches it; may be a symlink alias of `realPath`.

via.description: For imports: the files that led here, root instruction file first.

patterns.description: For `on-path` entries: the globs, or the directory, that trigger loading, as written.

size.description: What the entry adds to context. For a skill, its listing text.

deferred.description: For a skill: the body, loaded only when the skill is used.

truncated.description: Set when a limit cuts the file: the byte where the cut falls and its line.

inventoryId.description: For MCP servers and hooks: the id of the matching inventory item.

ownContext.description: For a subagent the agent loads: what its own context window starts with when it runs, as far as the repository shows. Not part of the plan's totals.

kind.description: `prompt`: the subagent's own prompt. `instructions`: the instruction files the session loads at startup. `skill`: the body of a skill the `skills` field preloads. `listing`: the session's skills listing, as Codex's skills instructions block. `memory`: the part of its MEMORY.md the agent memory adds.

path.description: For a skill: its SKILL.md. For memory: its MEMORY.md.

notLoaded.description: Skills of the first 32 the `skills` field names that the subagent does not get.

overLimit.description: How many more distinct skills the `skills` field names past the first 32, none of which loads.

unmeasured.description: Files the call starts with that the scan did not read, such as a preloaded skill larger than it reads: `size` leaves them out.

memory.description: The agent memory `memory` adds to the prompt (the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md), measured as a `memory` part when the scan read the file.

notVisible.description: What the subagent also starts with that no file in the repository shows.

skippedLoad.description: A file or item the agent would consider but skips.

ruleId.description: The loading rule whose finding reports this skip. Absent only for `not-read`.

size.description: What the agent would receive if it loaded the file.

fix.description: How the fix on the finding of `ruleId` on `path` is applied, when it has one: its class (`safe`, `review`), or `input` when it needs your words, which only `agentcheckup fix -i` asks for.

ownContext.description: For a subagent another definition of its name may win over, where the agent does not document which one: what its call starts with if it is the one that loads.

outOfScope.description: A file the plan leaves out on purpose.

assumption.description: A setting the repository cannot show, stated so that the reader can check it.

hiddenScope.description: A scope outside the repository that can add to the plan. Listed, never read.

locations.description: Display text such as `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. Never resolved or read.

limitUsage.description: How much of a documented limit the repository uses.

unit.description: `levels`: directory levels below a search root. `directories`: directories a search visits.

limit.description: Null when the limit depends on the model's context window and none was given.

subject.description: What the usage is measured on, always a path: a file, a directory, or for a group of files (Codex's AGENTS.md chain, a skills listing) the working directory it is computed for. Empty for the scan root. With `key`, identifies the usage.

label.description: Words for a subject that stands for a group of files, such as `AGENTS.md chain`. Display text only, never a path.

loadPlan.description: What one agent loads for a session started in `cwd`.

cwd.description: Working directory of the session. Empty for the scan root.

entries.description: Sorted by position, trigger, path, id.

onDemand.description: The most that other triggers can add.

incomplete.description: Parts that could not be analyzed, so entries may be missing: `markdown-budget:<path>`, `unparsed:<path>`, `unread:<path>`, `fallback:<path>`.

ignored.description: How many files the agent may load that the plan does not show because the configuration's `ignore` matches them, or matches the only way to them. Absent when none.

matrixCell.description: `not-read`: the agent does not read this file (shown as "—").

tokenSummary.description: `agentcheckup tokens`: what each agent's configuration costs in context, in ≈tokens (characters / 4), from the load plans.

agents.description: The plans of the working directory, in platform order.

startup.description: In context from the first message, listings included.

listings.description: Of startup: the names and descriptions the model picks skills and subagents by.

onDemand.description: The most later triggers can add.

subagents.description: Subagents the agent loads, each with a call of its own.

calls.description: What each subagent call starts with, with the model it runs on as far as the repository says: calls nothing of can be measured first, then the largest. A call that may run instead of a preferred one has `mayRun`.

tokens.description: Absent when nothing of the call can be measured; a lower bound when `unmeasured` names files.

unmeasured.description: Files the call starts with that the scan did not read.

directories.description: With --by-directory: the start directories planned besides the root, largest first.

contextReport.description: Load plans: what each agent loads (`agentcheckup context`, or a scan with `--context`).

agents.description: In platform order. Matrix cell `i` belongs to agent `i`.

directories.description: With `tokens --by-directory`: what a session started in each directory planned besides the root starts with, per agent, sorted by directory, and how many more directories hold agent configuration but were not planned. Totals only, without the plans.

sources.description: Every source cited by `evidence`, by key, sorted.

packageSpec.description: How an MCP server's code is fetched.

file.description: The config file that declares the item.

digest.description: Hash of the redacted entry. The same id with another digest: the item changed.

origin.description: URL origin only, never the path or query.

status.description: What each agent that reads `file` does with the server.

scope.description: `subagent`: declared in a subagent's frontmatter, connected only while that subagent runs. Absent for a server in a configuration file.

id.description: `hook:<file>#<event>:<digest of command>`, plus an occurrence number for repeats.

file.description: The config file that declares the item.

digest.description: Hash of the redacted entry. The same id with another digest: the item changed.

known.description: False when the event is not documented, so the hook never runs.

script.description: The repository script the command runs, when it can be told.

failsOpen.description: True when an error or timeout lets the action go ahead.

remoteScript.description: True when the command downloads and runs a script.

scope.description: Where a hook declared in frontmatter applies. `subagent`: only while that subagent runs. `skill`: from the turn a skill or command is invoked to the end of the session. Absent for a hook in a configuration file, which applies to every session.

effective.description: False when `disableAllHooks` in the repository's own settings turns the hook off, such as in Claude Code's project settings. Such a hook does not meet a policy's hook requirement.

file.description: The config file that declares the item.

digest.description: Hash of the redacted entry. The same id with another digest: the item changed.

broad.description: True when the value grants wide access.

effective.description: False when the agent ignores the value where it is set.

file.description: The config file that declares the item.

digest.description: Hash of the redacted entry. The same id with another digest: the item changed.

shown.description: For `endpoint` only: the URL origin. Never a credential value.

effective.description: False when the agent drops the override where it is set, such as an OpenTelemetry exporter variable in Claude Code's project settings.

inventory.description: Security inventory: every MCP server, hook, permission and environment override in the repository, in configuration files and in the frontmatter of Claude Code skills, commands and subagents, whether or not an agent loads it. Never holds credential values.

incomplete.description: Config files that could not be analyzed, so items may be missing.

agents.description: Agent definitions: the custom agents and subagents of the repository, once for each agent that reads the file from the repository root, and the repository settings that pick models.

modelValue.description: A model as written: one string, or a list of strings for an agent that takes several.

agentDefinition.description: One agent definition as one agent reads it.

id.description: `agent:<file>@<agent>`, or `agent:<file>#<role>@codex` for a role a `.codex/config.toml` declares without an agent file.

status.description: What the agent does with the file.

reason.description: Why the agent skips it, may not load it, or shadows it.

shadowedBy.description: For shadowed: the file of the definition that wins.

form.description: How the value is written, as the reading agent documents its values.

effective.description: The model the definition runs with, as far as the repository says.

overridden.description: The setting that makes the agent ignore the definition's own model.

digest.description: Hash of the definition without its lines and its effective model.

modelSetting.description: A repository setting that picks a model or an effort for an agent's sessions or subagents, or the models allowed.

value.description: As written; a list joined with `, `.

applies.description: What it sets: the session's model or effort, the subagents', the models allowed, or what an alias resolves to.

itemDiff.description: Ids added, removed and changed between the baseline and this scan, sorted.

planDelta.description: Change in one load plan present in both reports.

calls.description: Subagents whose own context, in ≈tokens per call, differs. `before` is null for one the baseline does not have, `after` for one the scan no longer lists or, with `unmeasured`, can no longer measure.

gateHit.description: One change that trips the gate.

id.description: The inventory item id; for `unicode`, the finding's fingerprint.

summary.description: One line for the pull request summary. Untrusted text.

kind.description: A setting that trips the gate whenever it is set or changed: `mode` for a permission mode, `agent` for the subagent every Claude Code session starts as, `model-setting` for a repository setting that picks a model.

baselineDiff.description: Comparison with the `--baseline` report. Paths are compared after removing each report's `pathBase`.

against.description: The baseline report's tool and rule set versions.

newRules.description: Rules this scan ran that are newer than the baseline's rule set, sorted. Their findings count as new; reports label them "new rule".

resolved.description: Baseline findings with no match in this scan, sorted by path.

agents.description: Agent definitions and model settings by id. Absent in comparisons made before they were listed.

context.description: Only for (agent, cwd) pairs present in both reports.

hits.description: Changes that trip the gate. Removals never do.
